name: go-streams-live-flow-state-transfer
instr:
go-streams cannot transfer operator state to fresh Flow instances without draining or replaying accepted input. Make state transfer optional and portable while preserving aggregation, partitioning, timing, pacing, and completion behavior. Pipelines that do not use it must remain compatible.

`StateControllerFor` must discover support without consuming, emitting, or closing elements, returning `ErrFlowStateUnsupported` otherwise. Capture a quiescent, independently owned `FlowState` with a nonzero version, operator identity, and deterministic payload. Supported Go values must round-trip; reject unrepresentable values. Later payload mutation must not affect captured or restored state.

Validate the complete image, including nested keyed state, before mutation. Report `ErrFlowStateBusy`, `ErrFlowStateCorrupt`, `ErrFlowStateVersion`, or `ErrFlowStateMismatch` as appropriate, leaving execution usable and externally unchanged after failure.

Batch must restore partial ordered batches, emitting on size or closure without duplication. Fold and Reduce must retain their distinct initialization and accumulation rules. Keyed must restore each key, supplier, accumulator, and recursive operator identity independently, rejecting incompatible suppliers before more input.

Map, Filter, FlatMap, and PassThrough may capture only at completed element boundaries and must not serialize functions. A blocked Map reports busy, then captures after quiescence and drains its completed result through To.
